title: M9 Map Completion — South Mountain Hex Digitization (#669)
notes: Phase 1 (typing the 841 then-recorded hexes) complete: all 376 unknown hexes set to clear (unknown ≈ clear per design decision). Phase 2 (hexside features: roads, streams, stone walls, fords) deferred to manual Map Editor work, tracked in #685. Track was previously marked status: 'complete' in tracks.md, which overstated matters further: the underlying map had real coverage gaps beyond hexside features (only ~37% of the 2240-cell grid had any hex record, 6/10 VP hexes unreachable). Corrected during /team-review on docs-issue-sync_20260811 (PR #687); coverage gap tracked in #689 and resolved by map-data-recovery_20260811 (2261 hexes, full grid coverage, all VP hexes reachable). That same recovery substantially advanced this track's own deferred Phase 2 too — 777/2261 hexes now carry edge/hexside data — but Phase 2 stays open here since the recovered data hasn't been visually audited against sm-map.jpg for road/stream/wall network completeness; that audit is #685's remaining scope, not this track's.
